items.title: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Posts Phase 4 STAR Win In Psoriatic Arthritis
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) reported new Phase 4 STAR trial results for TREMFYA in psoriatic arthritis with axial involvement. The Phase 4 data showed statistically significant improvements in MRI confirmed spinal inflammation for adults in the TREMFYA treatment arm. Patients in the study also reported significant gains in pain and function scores, aligning with the MRI based inflammation findings.
